_note: Every number used on screen lives here with its source. verified=false means placeholder or approximate: Person C must confirm before the pitch.

hgv_artic_avg_laden_kg_per_tkm.label: Articulated HGV (>33t), average laden
hgv_artic_avg_laden_kg_per_tkm.source: UK Government GHG Conversion Factors 2025 (DESNZ), road freight, diesel artic >33t, average laden, fuel combustion (as listed on Climatiq)

diesel_van_avg_kg_per_km.label: Diesel van up to 3.5t, average
diesel_van_avg_kg_per_km.source: UK Government GHG Conversion Factors 2025 (DESNZ), 'Diesel van - average (up to 3.5 tonnes) - freighting goods' (as listed on Climatiq)

short_haul_flight_kg_per_pkm.label: Short-haul international flight, economy, with radiative forcing
short_haul_flight_kg_per_pkm.source: Approximate: UK Government conversion factors (2021 set) as listed on Climatiq. Replace with the 2025/2026 'Business travel - air' value.

mk_to_monza.label: Milton Keynes to Monza via Dover-Calais

hgv_avg_kmh.label: HGV average speed
hgv_avg_kmh.source: Team assumption: EU HGVs are limited to 90 km/h; allows for traffic

single_driver_daily_driving_h.label: Single driver: max daily driving
single_driver_daily_driving_h.source: EU drivers' hours rules (Reg. 561/2006): 9 h a day, extendable to 10 h twice a week

team_driving_h_per_day.label: Two drivers: driving per day
team_driving_h_per_day.source: EU drivers' hours rules: each driver max 9 h a day (10 h only twice a week), so two drivers = 18 h. Conservative.

break_h_per_4_5h.label: Break after 4.5 h driving
break_h_per_4_5h.source: EU drivers' hours rules: 45 min break after 4.5 h
